entities.summary: Daniel K. Tarullo is an American law professor who served as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors from 2009 to 2017. Tarullo concurrently served as the chairman of the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC). In February 2017, he announced his intention to resign from the Board of Governors in early April 2017.
